label: Waar is Peter? (L1: home/thuis)
description: Basic location query for Peter. Minimum passing bar: model reports Peter is home. The home state has person.peter=home. Device tracker phone_peter=not_home (different tracker — should NOT be used as ground truth).
ideal_result_description: Responds in Dutch. Reports Peter is home (person.peter = home). Does NOT report 'not_home' based on the stale device_tracker.phone_peter — that tracker is not the primary source. Bonus: mentions the werkkamer (see tc_peter_werkkamer_002).
